Manchester climate startup Cellarstone raises £750,000 for battery software

Cellarstone, a Manchester-based climate technology startup, has raised £750,000 in a seed round to grow its battery-health analytics software.

The company helps warehouse operators extend the life of forklift fleets, and says early customers have cut replacement costs by a third.

The investment was announced alongside a partnership with a large logistics group, and Cellarstone plans to open its first overseas office next year.
